title: A story of a soldier killed in a foxhole by a snake
summary: Smith and another man trade a story of a soldier in a maneuver foxhole bitten by a snake or shot by machine guns.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: But anyway, they was out on maneuver, and they had them crawl on the fists and go on, and he crawled up on a snake and raised up, and they were shooting (?) with a machine gun.
And the snake crawled in the hole...
So he jumped up out of the hole and...

And he ran and jumped in the hole... When he ran and jumped in the foxhole... See, what they'd do, they would have you get in the foxhole and have a tank running down through there to run over the hole, and that's the way you got out of the way of
the tank. And he jumped in the hole, and jumped in there on a snake. The snake had crawled in the hole and he didn't know it.
So he got killed by the snake or the tank?
The snake. The snake bit him.
The boy told me that he raised up and then cut in half by the machine guns.
The way I heard it... He might have raised up and got shot, but the snake bit him while he was in the hole. I know another boy got bit three times in the hole.
Yeah, they tell me there was a boy out here in Arizona, and he jumped down there and there were about four or five rattlesnakes in one of them holes...
